site.description: Dalex Software: new games for the ZX Spectrum, playable in your browser.
site.intro: Games for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum from a small Manchester software house. Try the free demos in your browser.
site.footer: A Manchester games house, est. 1987. Dalex Software and INK & PAPER are fictional; the games are real.
